data.title: FunkNetz Mobil order confirmation – Smart M mobile contract
data.summary: FunkNetz Mobil GmbH confirms your mobile contract FunkNetz Smart M, ordered on 11 November 2024, at €34.99 per month with a 24-month minimum term starting 15 November 2024.
data.explanation: This confirms your mobile phone contract. It runs for a minimum of 24 months from 15 November 2024. You can cancel with one month's notice to the end of that minimum term, in text form (for example by email) or via the customer portal. If you don't cancel in time, it continues indefinitely and can then be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. The app calculates the cancellation deadline. Nothing else needs to be done now, but keep this letter and the contract summary.
